text:
Eli: Quick thread to lock a compact pilot triage matrix we can paste into DP invites. want it two lines + a tiny checklist.
Sofia: Love compact. propose 3 buckets: Critical (blocks pilot), Engineering (API/infra work), Low-lift (UX/docs/workarounds).
Hector: Ops: call out capacity work separately if it needs new pools/quota - that needs ~3w runway.
Nia: CS asks: partners expect a timely reply. can we promise an acknowledgement within 48h and a firm ETA for Critical within 72h?
Eli: Agree. Proposed public blurb: "We acknowledge partner requests within 48 hours. Items that prevent the pilot from running (Critical) will receive a target ETA within 72 hours. Engineering work that requires infrastructure or capacity may need additional lead time (typically ~3 weeks); we'll flag that up front. Credits for engineering work done during the pilot are considered case-by-case and require product+finance signoff."
Sofia: Suggest labels for tickets: `dp:critical`, `dp:engineering`, `dp:lowlift`, plus `dp:credits` and `dp:capacity` for ops-heavy asks.
Hector: Internal rule: if dp:capacity -> ops must be notified and lead-time >= 3w before any dev starts.
Nia: Suggest we track `dp:ack_ts` and `dp:eta_ts` fields so CS can report back to partners.
Eli: Decision: adopt blurb + labels + SLA. Credits: only when we allocate eng time inside the pilot window and approved by product+finance.
Sofia: AIs:
- Nia: post the one-paragraph blurb in the DP invite template by EOD.
- Hector: add dp:capacity guidance to ops runbook (tomorrow).
- Sofia: PR for ticket labels/fields to tracker (after lunch).
Eli: We'll try this for the next 6 partners and revisit. Thanks.
ops-bot: Note: legal/compliance must review any changes to retention/logging/access before work begins.
